purpose: Low-cost causal screen of a new first-image VLM before five-fold training

selection_time_rationale.fold_0: largest positive fold delta for experiment 260 inside locked Public-190
selection_time_rationale.fold_3: only negative and largest adverse fold delta for experiment 260 inside locked Public-190

calibration: For fold 0 the category threshold is fitted only on fold 3; for fold 3 it is fitted only on fold 0
limitations: A two-fold screen is only a compute gate. Passing it authorizes, but does not replace, full locked_190_nested_v1 evaluation.
